{{Top|leg}}
[[File:ShataLeatherPantsTCWBRBD2.png|thumb|200px|Pants made of leather]]
'''Leather''' was a material used for various purposes across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Several varieties existed, such as [[Sullust leather]] and [[Corellian leather]]. [[Shata leather pants/Legends|Shata leather pants]] were made of this substance.

Leather could be used to make [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], such as [[Jacket/Legends|jackets]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
